title: console: a comment edit stops writing `is_edited` / `edited_at` — the platform stamps both (objectui half of ruling A on objectstack#23124)
body:
Filing gate **④ coordination node**: the objectui-layer child of the cross-repo ruling objectstack-ai/objectstack#23124 (ruling A, comment `6137155820`). Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560) · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`. It goes in as `pm:on-hold` because the platform half is merged but not yet published, as the platform seat's landing note `6138611286` on objectstack#23124 asks.

- **Who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat, once the `Restart-when:` probe below exits 0. That is one dev and one small PR in `packages/app-shell`.
- **Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` on objectui, closed included, for `console stops writing comment is_edited edited_at handleEditComment server stamps edited marker`. It returned 5 hits: #12268, #12249, #12206, #12078 and #3116. None is this change. #12268 (closed) is the console feature that added the client-side write; the ruling's question was raised from its Acceptance note.

## What the ruling settled

- **Ruling A.** The platform stamps `is_edited: true` and `edited_at` on `sys_comment` when the body changes, both fields are read-only to data entry, and the console drops its own two-line write.
- **The platform half has landed.** objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #23153 merged as `dc93781c19` (2026-10-13T05:00Z):
  - `stampCommentBodyEdit` in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts` is registered as `beforeUpdate` on `sys_comment`.
  - `sys-comment.object.ts` declares both fields `readonly: true`.
  - `@objectstack/plugin-audit` ships it through `.changeset/23124-comment-edit-stamp.md` (`minor`, BREAKING narrowing) at the next version release.
- **The landing note, verbatim:** "Until the console drops the write, a `mentions`-only save answers 200 with `droppedFields` naming both fields and a warn line (`6138330704`)."

## The objectui half

- **Where the write is.** On objectui `main` `093d55b`, `handleEditComment` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` writes `is_edited: true` and `edited_at: new Date().toISOString()` with the new body. Its docblock says the server stamps neither field on update. Re-check: `grep -n "is_edited\|edited_at" packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`.
- **Wanted on restart:**
  - The edit save no longer sends `is_edited` or `edited_at`. Everything else it sends today stays.
  - The docblock says the platform stamps both fields.
  - The display keeps reading `edited: c.is_edited === true`.
  - A pin asserts the edit save's payload carries neither field.
  - ⛔ No client-side stamp is kept as a fallback, because the ruling makes both fields read-only to clients.
- **Why it waits.** Dropping the write now would lose the "edited" marker on every server running `@objectstack/plugin-audit` `17.7.0`, which is npm `latest` (published 2026-10-06) and stamps nothing.
- **Negative control,** run at filing time against `@objectstack/plugin-audit@latest` (`17.7.0`): the probe below exits 1.
  - The bundled `dist/index.js` is not minified. It keeps hook function names, for example `registerHook("beforeUpdate", enforceFeedsCapability`.
  - It holds no `stampCommentBodyEdit`.

Restart-when: an `@objectstack/plugin-audit` release carrying objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #23153 (`dc93781c19`) is published on npm: in a new empty directory, `npm pack @objectstack/plugin-audit@latest --silent >/dev/null && tar -xzf objectstack-plugin-audit-*.tgz && grep -q stampCommentBodyEdit package/dist/index.js` exits 0.
